description: Place an image, PDF or Illustrator page, InDesign page, EPS or SVG with its import options set without the dialog, on a page or into an existing frame (replacing its content), then optionally fit it and add a static caption (File > Place > Show Import Options: Image Import Options, Place PDF, Place InDesign Document, EPS Import Options; Replace Selected Item; Create Static Captions)

createFrames.description: Create Frames from EPS bounding box

proxy.description: Proxy Generation: AS_NEEDED uses the TIFF or PICT preview, ALWAYS rasterizes the PostScript

filePath.description: The file to place (inside the allowed directories)

fit.description: Fit the placed graphic in its frame afterwards (Object > Fitting)

frameId.description: Place into this frame, replacing its content (Replace Selected Item)

image.description: Image Import Options, also used for EPS clipping paths (applyClippingPath)

alphaChannel.description: Alpha Channel to mask the image with, by name

applyClippingPath.description: Apply Photoshop Clipping Path saved in the image

layers.description: Show Layers: layer visibility by name; a nested layer as "Group/Layer"

profile.description: Colour profile (Enable Color Management / Profile): USE_DOCUMENT (Use Document Default), WORKING, NO_CMS, POSTSCRIPT_CMS, or a profile name from the image's profileList (get_placed_graphic_options)

whenUpdatingLink.description: When Updating Link: keep these layer visibility overrides, or use the file's own visibility

crop.description: Crop to: page bounding box, bleed or slug

intoSelection.description: Place into the selected frame, replacing its content (Replace Selected Item)

pageIndex.description: Page to place on (0-based), unless frameId or intoSelection is given

crop.description: Crop to: bounding box (CROP_CONTENT_*), art, crop (CROP_PDF), trim, bleed or media

password.description: Password to open a protected PDF (put back after placing; never returned)

staticCaption.description: Add a static caption from the image's metadata after placing (Create Static Captions)

x.description: Left of the placed graphic, mm from the page's left edge

y.description: Top of the placed graphic, mm from the page's top edge

name: place_graphic_with_options
title: Place Graphic With Options
